name: acs-tract-demographics
title: ACS tract-level demographics (DE)
description: One row per Delaware Census tract. Variables drawn from ACS 5-year (vintage in etl_parameters.acs_vintage). All counts are persons.

fields.name: median_household_income
fields.description: ACS B19013_001E — median household income (USD). May be null for low-population tracts.

fields.name: median_family_income
fields.description: ACS B19113_001E — median family income (USD). Used in the SB 254 low-income MFI test.

fields.name: poverty_denominator
fields.description: ACS B17001_001E — persons for whom poverty status is determined.

fields.name: poverty_rate
fields.description: Computed: poverty_numerator / poverty_denominator. 0..1 scale. Used in the SB 254 low-income poverty test.

fields.name: race_white_nh
fields.description: ACS B03002_003E — not Hispanic, White alone.

fields.name: race_black_nh
fields.description: ACS B03002_004E — not Hispanic, Black alone.

fields.name: race_asian_nh
fields.description: ACS B03002_006E — not Hispanic, Asian alone.

fields.name: ethnicity_hispanic
fields.description: ACS B03002_012E — Hispanic or Latino (any race).
